item.title: The Derby Del Camino Real Comes To The Open Cup For The Second Straight Year - New Mexico United
item.description: The rivalry between New Mexico and El Paso has been a must see event since the two clubs met for the first time in 2019. United leads the all-time match up across all competitions with a 7-8-5 (W-D-L) record. The last time these two sides met in this competition was on April 16th, 2025 in Albuquerque. El Paso advanced to the next round on penalties 4-1.
